observed.training_trace: jspace_training_trace_v1.py now validates digest-stable HCU_INFERENCE_RECEIPT/v3 for non-UNKNOWN credit and binds that receipt to generation, Entry event/admission, route decision and model role.
observed.dataset_boundary: compile_jspace_bootstrap_dataset_v1.py now requires an external admitted J-Space basis registry and validates packet generation/basis/role/control-condition plus trace identity.
observed.remaining_gap: grid_plan_sha256 is still accepted as an independent caller-supplied digest in the training trace. Neither the prototype J-Space basis identity nor the admitted-basis registry cryptographically commits to the Entry event/admission + route decision + GRID10 plan tuple. Therefore GRID10 plan identity remains outside the J-Space causal basis binding.

counterhypothesis: An upstream controller may always supply a correct grid_plan_sha256 together with a separately admitted basis, making the missing in-trace binding operationally harmless.
why_counterhypothesis_is_not_yet_suffici: The trace is explicitly used as exact causal training evidence and the dataset compiler can consume serialized traces. A basis registry of basis_id -> basis_sha256 proves basis admission but not its relation to the causal Entry/route/GRID10 tuple. Exact-scope training evidence should fail closed under plan/route relabelling rather than rely on an unstated upstream convention.

falsifier.name: GRID_PLAN_IDENTITY_TRANSPLANT
falsifier.prediction_if_gap_exists: A valid UNKNOWN-credit trace can be rebuilt with only grid_plan_sha256 changed, while keeping the same prototype step/vector-control packet and a recomputed outer trace_sha256; source inspection predicts no J-Space basis mismatch because current basis validation is independent of grid_plan_sha256.
falsifier.prediction_if_gap_closed: The builder or compiler rejects before dataset admission because the J-Space basis identity/digest no longer matches the causal Entry+route+GRID10 binding.

recommended_minimal_repair.rule: Derive the request-scoped J-Space basis identity/digest from the complete causal tuple; require prototype step, vector-control packet and dataset compiler to match that binding. This is a verification binding only and must not become a second Entry/router/GRID authority.
recommended_minimal_repair.compiler_rule: Recompute or verify the same causal binding at serialized dataset admission so a rehashed outer trace cannot relabel a valid prototype step onto a different GRID10 plan.

next_exact_step: After the active PR1263 writer lane stabilizes, fuse the minimal causal grid-binding repair into the existing jspace_training_trace/dataset path, then run the exact current combined HCU regressions in an actually-started authorized FREE isolated sandbox.
